title: ArcCivs NEW ordinary gate aperture stage1:3x3 to5x5
assumptions: Prospective geometry decision before footprint edit. Before is the unreleased v5 candidate3x3/one-wide-core; after is the proposed5x5/three-wide-core, under the SAME existing gate recipe and material prices. Neither row claims current live211income.

Only NEW UNPAID ordinary min-cut passages are changed. Paid/adopted footprints and routes remain unchanged; the separate fortified radius2/depth9 branch is unchanged. Initial fresh villages remain halfwidth32/protection96, not enlarged to fit gates.

Exact flat AIR-baseline structural state counts come from enumerating the current gate/Materials loops; all slabs single. Native Terraform, terrain grading, replacement wall strips and reconnected roads are separate ordinary quotes, not included here.
Low/base/high1/5/15 settlements each build one new gate in a hypothetical week. Each stage is a SEPARATE alternative, not three simultaneous activities; do not sum the stage scenarios.

Local near crossing groups use one coherent passage, with remaining contour cells becoming wall. Do not infer total town savings from73versus45: gate count, wall and road costs also change and need the admitted native plan.

prospective_new_road_alignment.scope: Before route edit: synthetic compact FORESTER only; unpaid road, unchanged gate/collar/paid roads. Desired frontage alignment, not a live quote.
prospective_new_road_alignment.limits: Same material/work-speed/AutoSupplies/routing-budget rules. Native lane union, grading and any paving material difference require the existing exact admitted quote; equal centreline length is not a claim of equal total paving or universal native journey time.

prospective_full_shared_streets.policy: New unpaid gated roads share a center-axis street with nonnegative planning-cost penalties only. Same route/node/length/grade/protection limits; no second search and no synthetic native/paid standing. Paid/actual roads, gate recipes/stages, payouts, work speed and AutoSupplies unchanged.
prospective_full_shared_streets.assessment_limits: Road vectors may lengthen/shorten; shared paving may change. No claim of production acceleration or equal item burn. Authored states are not monetary units nor a native inventory bill; fixed ordinary quote prices are unchanged. Measure synthetic after deltas before publication, native costs/progress after activation.
prospective_full_shared_streets.native_quote_status: NOT_APPLIED: LAB stopped after wipe. These are flat synthetic authored geometry measures, not native debit, mint, inventory burn, or measured production.

prospective_unpaid_fortified_reconnect.scope: Before activation: allow existing fresh unpaid gate-axis reconnect for fortified frames too; paid/adopted infrastructure and routes remain excluded.
prospective_unpaid_fortified_reconnect.before: Provisional routes may meet solid flank of unchanged deep fort gate; normal proof rejects candidate and falls back to no optional forts.
prospective_unpaid_fortified_reconnect.after: Same bounded route search reconnects new roads through explicit gate-side center; planning channel follows unchanged gate bounds expanded by four columns.
prospective_unpaid_fortified_reconnect.policy: Gate/wall recipes, item unit prices, payouts, working speed, AutoSupplies and search budgets unchanged. No refund or manufactured treasury. Roads/ground and optional fortification material quantities may change and remain subject to existing exact native quote.
prospective_unpaid_fortified_reconnect.native_quote_status: NOT_APPLIED: LAB stopped after authorized wipe; prospective road/profile admission correction, not a measured item or money flow.

prospective_fortified_exit_separation.scope: Before activation: reject only new unpaid fortified perimeter proposals whose portal centers are at most16Manhattan blocks apart; existing bounded optional fortification-count fallback chooses another coherent plan. Paid/adopted plans unchanged.
prospective_fortified_exit_separation.desired: A coherent bounded alternative, prospectively2optional forts with gates at-37/0/37; actual postchange counts must be measured, not guaranteed.
prospective_fortified_exit_separation.limits: No refund, rate, price, speed, AutoSupplies or material recipe change. Fewer optional structures can lower item sinks; actual gate/wall/road/fort/terrain bill remains normal captured native quote, not converted to a fictitious currency. LABstopped so no native item/money flow measured.
